_meta.source: arXiv:1904.10447v4, I. Boiarska et al., 'Phenomenology of GeV-scale scalar portal'
_meta.extracted_from: Appendix 'Form-factors for the flavor changing neutral current meson decays' (main.tex lines 1079-1348)

units.uncertainties: absolute, same units as central value

_meta.q2_convention: q^2 = (p_X - p_X')^2, evaluated at q^2 = m_S^2 for 2-body decays X -> X' S; pole factors are (1 - q^2/m^2). For 3-body X -> X' SS, q^2 is the SS invariant mass squared in [4 m_S^2, (m_X - m_X')^2].
_meta.mixing_angle_convention: theta is the mixing angle itself (field shift h -> h + theta S); all rates are normalised by theta^2. No sin(theta) symbol is used.
_meta.M_XX_convention: Scalar hadronic matrix element entering BR as |M_XX'(m_S^2)|^2; see reference markdown Sec. 0.4 for the two definitions and their ordering/parity caveats.

B->K0*(700):sca.M_XX: M_XStilde = i*(m_X^2 - m_Stilde^2 - q^2)/(m_Qj + m_Qi) * f_+^{XStilde}(q^2)
B->K0*(700):sca.note: K0*(700) assumed di-quark state; large theoretical uncertainty (Issadykov:2015iba, Daldrop:2012sr, Cheng:2013fba); no uncertainty on F0,a,b quoted

B->K0*(1430):sca.M_XX: M_XStilde = i*(m_X^2 - m_Stilde^2 - q^2)/(m_Qj + m_Qi) * f_+^{XStilde}(q^2)

B->K*(892):vec.m_R_symbol: m_B+ (per source table); 5.279 GeV = paper's B+- mass 5279 MeV

B->K*(1410):vec.form: A0 = (1 - 2*m_V^2/(m_B^2 + m_V^2 - q^2))*xi_par(q^2) + (m_V/m_B)*xi_perp(q^2); xi_perp/par(q^2) = xi_perp/par(0)/(1 - q^2/m_B^2)
B->K*(1410):vec.m_B_note: m_B is not restated in this subsection; assume the 5.3 GeV of the scalar subsection

B->K*(1680):vec.form: A0 = (1 - 2*m_V^2/(m_B^2 + m_V^2 - q^2))*xi_par(q^2) + (m_V/m_B)*xi_perp(q^2); xi_perp/par(q^2) = xi_perp/par(0)/(1 - q^2/m_B^2)

B->K1(1270):psv.m_K1_resonance_note: m_K1(1270) not tabulated in the paper

B->K1(1400):psv.m_K1_resonance_note: m_K1(1400) not tabulated in the paper

B->K2*(1430):ten.pole_mass_note: first pole at q^2 = m_X^2 and second series uses m_X (decaying meson), as printed; NOT m_B = 5.3 GeV

decay_constants_GeV.note: used only for the quartic-coupling channel X -> SS (Eq. eq:bstossbranching); no uncertainties quoted
